pageDescription: While you play it pauses services, closes background apps and frees memory; turning it off restores everything.
categoryMemoryDesc: Free up RAM for your game
optSvcWsearchDesc: Stops the indexing service that uses CPU and disk
optSvcSpoolerDesc: Stops the print service if you have no printer connected
optSvcDiagtrackDesc: Stops telemetry and diagnostic tracking services
optProcBrowsersDesc: Kill Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and other browsers
optProcChatDesc: Kill Discord, Slack, Teams, and other chat apps
optProcUpdatersDesc: Kill software update agents running in the background
optProcCustomDesc: Kill processes you specify by name
optMemStandbyDesc: Purge cached RAM to free memory for your game
optSysPowerPlanDesc: Switch to the maximum performance power profile
optSysPreventSleepDesc: Keep the display on and prevent the system from sleeping
optSysGameBarDesc: Turn off the Xbox Game Bar overlay and background recording
optSysFseOptDesc: Prevent Windows from applying DWM composition to fullscreen games
optSysTransparencyDesc: Turn off window transparency to reduce GPU compositing overhead
optNetFlushDnsDesc: Clear the DNS resolver cache for fresh lookups
optNetNagleDesc: Reduce network latency by disabling TCP packet batching
warningProcesses: Closed apps are not reopened when you turn game mode off.
noOptimizationsSelected: Select at least one optimization to turn game mode on
configLockedWhileActive: Turn game mode off to change the optimizations.
pendingRestoreBanner: Some settings from the last session were not restored. Retry once the cause is fixed (for example administrator rights).
pendingRestoreDiscardHint: If it keeps failing, discard the pending state to unblock game mode. Any settings still changed stay as they are.
discardDone: Pending state discarded: game mode can be turned on again
discardFailed: Could not discard the pending state
autoDetectDesc: Turns game mode on when a recognized game starts
autoDeactivateDesc: Restores the system settings when the game closes
customGameProcessesDesc: Add executable names of games not in the built-in list
receiptActivatedNote: turning it off puts the settings back; closed apps are not reopened
discardConfirmDescription: SuperSonicCleaner stops restoring the settings from the last session. Those still changed stay as they are and must be restored by hand.
restoreFailed_one: Restore incomplete: {{count}} setting still to restore ({{reason}})
restoreFailed_other: Restore incomplete: {{count}} settings still to restore ({{reason}})
invalidProcessName: A process name can contain only letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, underscores and spaces
